主な精霊をあげよう。
<pause>

火の<var_D200>、風の<var_CF00>。

<var_D500>、光の精霊<var_D600>など。

<pause>

Great Spirits--manifest themselves
in our physical world as follows:
<pause>
Gnome, of Earth;
Undine, of Water;
Efreet, of Fire;
<var_CF00>, of Wind.
<pause>

Maxwell, the Spirit of Molecules.
<pause>
Others include Luna, the Spirit of the
Moon, Shadow, the Spirit of
Darkness, and Aska, the Spirit of
Light.
<pause>

other spirits whose existence has
yet to be confirmed.{END}
